## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest relevant change.

## Trust boundary

Which model, state, artifact, network, credential, or execution boundary is affected?

## Verification

- [ ] Offline tests pass.
- [ ] Public release audit passes.
- [ ] Contract changes include regenerated schemas.
- [ ] No credentials, local outputs, downloaded Skills, papers, or datasets were added.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes.
